description: Curated animation cadence families for scripts/animation-cadence-audit.mjs (#214). Rates: browserPerVisit/nativePerVisit are frames per visit; *Visits is 'presentation' (24 Hz browser adapter for one native draw iteration) or 'logical' (12 Hz x speed world turns). browserFps/nativeFps give a fixed rate. status overrides the computed verdict only where no single rate applies. Anchors are regexes that must still match the owning source; a miss is reported as STALE.

families.family: native person counters, models 2-7 (Brave, Warrior, Preacher, Spy, Firewarrior, Shaman)
families.browserRule: stepObjectAnimation on logical visits for gated mode 1/2/4; mode 3 and morph transitions on presentation visits
families.nativeRule: 004d23ed ORs flags3 0x40100; 004ee7b0 advances gated modes only on stamped logical visits

families.family: native wild person counters (model 1: flight, fight, conversion records)
families.browserRule: draw 13 (mode 2 step 0) on every 24 Hz presentation visit: createLivePerson supplies no 0x40000 gate for model 1
families.nativeRule: 004d23d0 ORs flags3 0x40100 at 004d23ed before the model switch; the model-1 branch 004d2417 and tail 004d26d1 do not clear it (static read; callee 004d5920 only partly read) -> logical visits
families.note: Not sampled in ordinary AI play; needs a player conversion/flight witness and the full creation path before a repair.

families.note: Before #214 audit fix, floor((a/12 - b/12) x 12) fell one frame short for ~19% of turn pairs, shortening/doubling frames.

Since the descriptor-aware fallback, a Firewarrior's preceding legacy recoil pose runs at 6 fps, so this 12 fps sample can jump from frame k to about 2k at knockback start (person-record field; needs its own owner review).
